meta.title: Marikina City services (Citizen's Charter)

sources.covers: Fees, processing time, requirements and office for each service, 2022 edition

meta.notes: Only services read directly from the 2022 Citizen's Charter are listed (12 of the charter's many services); all other services are carry-over (see sprint blockers). Fees stated as "Based on ..." are ordinance-based in the charter itself. Processing times are as printed. The 2022 edition may be outdated; newer per-office charters are listed at fdpp.marikina.gov.ph/citizen-charter and were not compared. Staff names printed in the charter are deliberately omitted.

services.title: New Business Registration
services.description: Register a new business and get the permit assessed, billed and paid at the Treasury Office.
services.fee: Based on the Revenue Code of Marikina City (Chapters 4, 5, 6, 11, 10, 13, 26, 30, 33)
requirements: Zoning clearance (City Planning Office)
Photo of the establishment showing permanent signboard and sidewalk
DTI registration (sole proprietorship), SEC registration with Articles and Bylaws (corporation/partnership) or CDA registration (cooperative)
Valid ID
Certificate of Compliance
If representative: authorization from the owner, or Secretary's Certificate for a corporation

services.title: Renewal of Business Permit
services.description: Renew an existing business permit through the BPLO or online.
requirements: Marikina Business Portal compliance
Financial statement / quarterly VAT returns / monthly percentage tax (photocopies)
Valid ID (photocopy)
If representative: authorization from the owner, or Secretary's Certificate for a corporation

services.title: Change of Business Ownership
services.description: Amend a business registration to change the owner (single proprietorship or corporation).
services.fee: Based on the Revenue Code of Marikina City
requirements: Single proprietorship: DTI registration, affidavit of change of ownership, deed of conveyance, original business permit, authorization letter, valid IDs
Corporation to corporation: SEC amended registration, board resolution, Secretary's Certificate, original business permit, authorization letter, valid IDs
Public market stalls: goodwill/deed of assignment, market clearance, treasurer's clearance, death certificate and affidavit of agreement (where applicable)

services.title: Payment of Business Tax
services.description: Pay business tax at the Treasury Office using the BIN and the tax billing from the BPLO.
services.fee: Based on the assessment of the business
services.processingTime: About 3 minutes at the window (30-second queue number)
services.office: City Treasurer's Office, Business Tax Division
requirements: Business Identification Number (BIN)
Previous official receipt / tax billing from the BPLO

services.title: Community Tax Certificate (Cedula)
services.description: Get a Community Tax Certificate (cedula) at the Treasury Office.
services.processingTime: About 3 minutes at the window (30-second queue number)
services.office: City Treasurer's Office, Business Tax Division
requirements: Duly accomplished Community Tax Certificate (CTC) form (from the Treasury Help Desk)

services.title: Payment of Professional Tax
services.description: Annual professional tax for persons legally authorized to practice a profession; payable on or before January 31.
services.office: City Treasurer's Office, Business Tax Division
requirements: PRC or IBP identification card
Previous receipt

services.title: Real Property Tax Clearance
services.description: Certifies that real property tax payments are complete and up to date, for sale or loan transactions.
services.office: City Treasurer's Office, Real Property Tax Division (Teller 57)
requirements: Registered owner: photocopy of the current RPT official receipt and photocopy of a valid ID

Representative/buyer: photocopy of the current RPT official receipt, authorization letter or SPA from the owner, photocopies of the owner's and representative's valid IDs, and photocopies of the documents to be used in the sale or loan

services.title: Police Clearance (Payment of Fee)
services.description: Get an order of payment at the police station, then pay the fee at the Treasury cashier for the police clearance (employment, passport/visa, firearms, change of name, etc.).
services.fee: Based on the order of payment
services.processingTime: Order of payment 5 minutes, then payment at the cashier
services.office: Marikina Police Station and Treasury Cashier
requirements: Order of payment issued by the Police Station

services.title: Locational Clearance for Building Permit
services.description: Required before a building permit; checks that the building conforms with the Comprehensive Land Use Plan and zoning ordinance.
services.fee: Based on the order of payment (computed by the Planning Office; paid at the Treasury cashier)
services.processingTime: Simple transactions 5 days; highly technical transactions 20 days
requirements: 2 sets of complete plans (architectural, structural, electrical, plumbing)
Barangay clearance for construction
Lot plan signed and sealed by a geodetic engineer (2 sets)
Bill of materials signed and sealed by a licensed engineer/architect
Proof of ownership (certified true copy of the latest title, tax declaration of land and improvement)
Contract of lease (if renting)
Affidavit of undertaking
Notarized authorization letter or Secretary's Certificate for a representative
Notarized consent of immediate neighbors if needed
Other clearances under the 2005 National Building Code where necessary

charter.ref: City Planning and Development Office, p. 134; fees p. 102-103

services.title: Building Permit and Ancillary Permits
services.description: Processing and issuance of building and ancillary permits under the National Building Code (PD 1096).
services.fee: Based on the Philippine Electrical Code, Mechanical Code and National Building Code fee schedules
services.processingTime: 1 day and 3 hours in total (as stated in the charter)
requirements: TCT, tax declaration, tax receipt, bill of materials, specifications, CSHP certificate from DOLE, locational clearance
Signed and sealed construction plans (architectural, structural, lot plan, electrical, sanitary, mechanical)
Other government agency clearances as required

charter.ref: Office of the Building Official, p. 139

services.title: Sanitation and Health Certificate Fees
services.description: Pay sanitation and health certificate fees at the Treasury cashier after an order of payment from the City Health Office.
services.fee: Based on the order of payment
services.processingTime: Order of payment 5 minutes, then payment at the cashier
services.office: City Health Office and Treasury Cashier
requirements: Order of payment issued by the Health Office

services.title: Online Business Registration and Payment
services.description: Register and pay business fees online through the city's BPLO portal and online payment site.
services.fee: Based on the Revenue Code of Marikina City
requirements: Register on the BPLO portal (https://bplo.marikina.gov.ph/client/index)
Pay through https://payment.marikina.gov.ph/
